findingDetails.title: The recommend feature doc still says a hub suppresses a command its own command row already offers
findingDetails.scopeProof: The doc is the shared feature-catalog page for the changed handler, and the changed test is in the declared scope.
findingDetails.claim: The doc's blanket suppression sentence is false for the head row after the changed `|| index === 0` condition.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The sentence remains true for a non-head hub beside a command row; the finding scopes it to the head case the test proves.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The doc may describe the old behavior deliberately; the changed test expects the new behavior, so the doc is the stale side.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if the handler intentionally restores the old suppression.

findingDetails.title: The meaning-anchor feature doc still reports the old test count
findingDetails.scopeProof: The doc is the shared feature-catalog page for the changed scorer and names the changed test file.
findingDetails.claim: The doc says the test file has 17 cases; the file now has 28 it declarations.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The base file had 18 declarations and the doc said 17; the change added 10, so the sentence was already approximate and is now clearly stale.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The sentence could count only the meaning-anchor cases, but its list cannot include the six withhold cases either way.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if the doc is regenerated from a case-count source that excludes the withhold describes.

findingDetails.title: The phase 020 requirement still states a weak-cue bar of 10 while the accepted implementation uses 9
findingDetails.scopeProof: The constant is in the declared scorer scope; the phase spec and acceptance criteria are the packet docs that describe it.
findingDetails.claim: REQ-007 and the mechanism table say 10; T025 and AC-007 record 9; the code uses 9.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: The code matches the accepted T025 decision and the tune row at 9.51; the stale side is the requirement text, not the constant.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The requirement may intentionally describe the no-cue bar; it says 'weak problem cue', and the code has a separate weak constant.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Withdraw if REQ-007 is amended to 9 before the packet closes.
